templates.why_chosen: Dense 14-component figure whose red-numbered 1-8 sequence overlays a Borrower/Lender pair sharing a coherent memory space, with a top four-color legend (control, command, data, metadata) the reader must cross-reference against numbers placed far below it.
templates.what_to_learn: Number the resource-sharing protocol steps in one bold color directly on the repeated peer boxes (Borrower/Lender) so the sequence reads without a key; but place the flow-type legend near those numbers, not at the opposite end of the figure, since this one forces a long eye trip between the two.
